a: Nine connected modules: enquiries and pipeline, survey and quotation, delivery checklists, materials and stock, payments and expenses, AMC and service finance, reports, a partner portal, and roles with access control. One yearly plan covers all of them.

q: How do the modules work together?
a: They share one customer and one job record. A won quotation becomes a project, the project draws stock from your warehouses, and the stock, receipts and expenses on that project appear in your reports, so nothing is typed in twice.

q: Can we define our own delivery stages?
a: Yes. An administrator defines the stages, required documents and utility steps once. Every live job is then measured against that checklist, and each stage can be assigned to a named person.

q: Can our team use it from a phone?
a: Yes. Surveyors capture roof, electrical and structural details and location-stamped photos on a phone, and field crews work an assigned list and upload evidence from site.

q: Can our accountant keep using the accounting package they already use?
a: Yes. HelioLattice runs the operational money workflow next to the job and exports structured data to Excel, Tally XML and Tally JSON for your accountant.
